mend.text: Restore 30 health to one of your creatures.

study.text: Draw three cards. Empty draws cause escalating fatigue damage to your active creature.

seek.text: Find one base creature in your deck, put it in your hand, then shuffle.

ascend.text: Find one evolution in your deck, put it in your hand, then shuffle. It still needs normal evolution timing.

swap.text: Switch your active creature with a reserve creature for free. Clear toxin on the outgoing creature.

gust.text: Shuffle one random card from the opponent hand into their deck, then they draw one. No effect on an empty hand.

recover.text: Return one energy from your discard to your hand. Attaching still uses your turn attachment.

shelter.text: Give one creature a 20-point shield against the next direct attack.

blade.text: Equipped creature attacks deal 10 additional damage.

shell.text: Reduce every direct attack against the equipped creature by 10.
